content.body: The provenance object on each node records knowledge origin information: author, created_at (creation timestamp), signature (SHA-256 content hash), source_type (human / ai_generated / ai_verified). After edits, updated_at is added. AI-extracted nodes additionally record source_document and extraction_model (AI model used). Nodes copied to other knowledge bases record copied_from.node_id and copied_from.workspace_id. Provenance is always recorded, but does not impose access restrictions.
